environment: CP/M 2.2; z80pack cpmsim 1.39; Z80 CBIOS 1.2; fresh base066.dsk
procedure: Run FAULT066 N without arming injector
observed behavior: Returned 00; DMA first byte 41h; before/after image hashes equal
compatibility conclusion: Normal control; successful transfer is distinguishable from sentinel retained after injected failure

environment: same; port 18 deterministic one-shot read failure
procedure: Open ATTR.DAT; fill DMA EEh; arm OUT 1; read; answer x
observed behavior: Bad Sector intervention; returned 00 after ignore; DMA EEh retained; image unchanged
compatibility conclusion: Post-ignore result is not transfer validation; DMA data is not guaranteed

environment: same; port 18 deterministic one-shot write failure
procedure: Open CLOSEME.DAT; fill DMA 53h; arm OUT 2; write; answer x
observed behavior: Bad Sector intervention; returned 00 after ignore; image unchanged
compatibility conclusion: Post-ignore result is not persistence validation

environment: same; fresh image; each injected fault one-shot
procedure: Run modes A, C, A with x responses, then N
observed behavior: Three interventions; each ignored call returned 00; later read returned 00 with 41h; image unchanged
compatibility conclusion: Repeated physical failures remain operator interventions; later healthy I/O may recover

fault scenario: pre-transfer read failure followed by recovery
procedure: Ignore mode A; run DIR ATTR.DAT; run mode N
observed behavior: Caller returned; directory listing and normal read succeeded; image unchanged
compatibility conclusion: Ignore permits continuation, but affected call state remains unguaranteed

operation tested: BDOS 20, CCP warm recovery, DIR, BDOS 20
procedure: Run mode G; answer control-C; run DIR and mode N
observed behavior: No RETURNED from failed caller; A> appeared; DIR and normal read succeeded; image unchanged
compatibility conclusion: Abort abandons caller and establishes usable command environment; exact internals not required

environment: same, but no drive-B image attached
procedure: Run mode U; respond to repeated interventions
observed behavior: Two B-drive Bad Sector interventions captured; no application return; harness timed out before confirmed abort/recovery
compatibility conclusion: Unavailable-media repetition/timing is profile-dependent; no post-abort result claimed from this case

fault scenario: physical write completes before error status; ignore
procedure: Fill DMA with 50h; execute physical write then status 6; answer x
observed behavior: Bad Sector; returned 00; image changed; CLOSEME.DAT is 128 bytes 50h
compatibility conclusion: Failure can coexist with media change; no persistence, atomicity, or rollback guarantee

fault scenario: physical write completes before error status; control-C
observed behavior: No RETURNED; A> appeared; image and extracted file equal T08
compatibility conclusion: Abort restores execution control, not prior media state; no rollback guarantee
